verdict.rationale: Gusto's evidence exclusively describes it as an MCP *server* (the Embedded Dev Assistant MCP and mcp.api.gusto.com) that other AI tools like Cursor, Claude Desktop, and ChatGPT connect to and consume — the reverse role from the story, which asks whether a user can plug external MCP servers into Gusto so Gusto itself can use their tools. Gusto is a payroll/HR SaaS/API platform with no agentic assistant surface for consuming external tools, so this client-side MCP axis does not apply to its product category.
